releaseNotes: HCG Mail 1.0.0 | Public Beta 1: the first public beta of HCG Mail for Windows x64. Free, with no HCG account needed.
Email over IMAP (synchronisation) and SMTP (sending), with multiple accounts.
HTML and plain-text message viewing; mailbox and folder management.
HCG Dark and Light appearance, and Mail Health connection diagnostics.
Microsoft OAuth sign-in is outside the scope of this public beta: use IMAP and SMTP with a password or app password.
knownLimitations: Not code-signed (no Authenticode signature): Windows SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC". Choose More info, then Run anyway, only if the file's SHA-256 matches the published checksum.

Built by the HCG Mail team and attached to a GitHub release by hand: there is no CI build record or Release Passport for this file. HCG Store verified the file itself (checksum, version, architecture, start-up).
The program reports version 1.0.0 (file version 1.0.0.0); HCG Store lists it as 1.0.0-beta.1, Public Beta 1.
Start-up was verified on a GitHub-hosted Windows Server 2025 x64 runner, not yet on testers' own PCs. Signing in to a mailbox, sending and receiving were not tested by HCG Store.
Microsoft OAuth (Outlook.com, Microsoft 365) sign-in is outside the scope of this beta. Use IMAP and SMTP with a password or app password.
Windows x64 only: there is no Windows ARM64 build in this release. Updates are not automatic: a new version is a new download.
